mentions.name: UPSC Path
mentions.description: An exam-prep platform for India's UPSC Civil Services examination that indexes mock test copies of people who are now Indian Government officers. It is live, used by several thousand aspirants, and additional features are being built to make preparation slightly easier.
mentions.problem: The UPSC Civil Services exam is one of the most coveted exams in India, and the platform aims to make its preparation slightly easier.
mentions.audience: Aspirants preparing for India's UPSC Civil Services exam; the platform is already used by several thousand aspirants.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://upscpath.com

UPSC Civil Services exam is one of the most coveted exams in India (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Civil_Services_Examination). I created the platform which has indexed mock test copies of people who are now officers for the Indian Govt.

Now I am building additional features that make the prep slighly easier. The platform is already live and is being used by several thousand aspirants.
